baseline.note: Expected behavior comes from the verified static baseline/parity contract; this matrix records only current V2 source coverage and never converts source presence into runtime acceptance.

acceptanceRule: No row is PASS/ACCEPTED from source evidence alone. Hardware/media/runtime gates remain separate.

features.expected: UltraCar cockpit/home illustrated dashboard with V1 proportions/background/sidebar/shortcuts in DeX
features.gap: Home shell exists, but original six governed media are not legally staged and screenshot parity is not accepted.
features.actual: HomeActivity renders the V2 cockpit shell with governed background/logo/vehicle resource references, clock, settings and shortcut grid.

features.expected: Vehicle card/model/color selection, parked/moving images and license plate
features.gap: Two verified source vehicle choices, local model/color selection and bounded license-plate display are implemented. Vehicle model plus legacy migration flag and license-plate changes now require synchronous persistence success before refreshing or acknowledging the UI. Full V1 branded card styling, moving-state behavior and real-media parity remain open.
features.actual: VehicleActivity lets the user choose between the two existing source vehicle choices (Limo đỏ and Lamborghini trắng) and store a bounded local license plate. It commits vehicle model plus the legacy limo migration boolean and commits the normalized plate before showing success; Home renders the selected parked vehicle plus the saved plate.

features.expected: Real USB Host UVC streaming, image controls and USB permission lifecycle
features.gap: Runtime CAMERA permission is now a fail-visible gate before any UVC controller start; USB-device permission remains device-scoped in the UVC library. Real USB camera grant/preview/reconnect behavior still requires physical-device acceptance.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity checks android.permission.CAMERA before calling UsbUvcController.start(), requests the Android runtime permission through the system prompt only, keeps denial visible, and allows the user to retry. UsbUvcController separately discovers USB video-class devices, requests device permission through the UVC library, opens preview, and performs bounded recovery for a still-attached device.

features.expected: Separate camera window with manual open/close while preserving real camera video
features.gap: Separate window, manual toggle and display-affinity source exist; real USB video/device behavior and cross-display runtime acceptance remain unaccepted.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity keeps same-display shortcut taps as a toggle, but when a camera window exists on another display it requests a dedicated camera task on the requested display and closes the stale window only after the display-specific launch succeeds.

features.expected: Reverse signal plus 0.5m/1.0m/1.5m parking guide activation and calibration
features.gap: Owner private Drive video IMG_7926.MOV verifies a tall narrow UltraCar panel beside Maps and reverse-camera windows on DeX. V2 now has an evidence-backed narrow HOME panel, but automatic Samsung window sizing/placement, verified vehicle reverse-signal input, guide calibration and real-device acceptance remain open.
features.actual: HomeActivity switches to a dedicated narrow DeX HOME panel only when its own desktop window is tall/narrow. The panel preserves V2 logo/background/clock/vehicle and bounded Google Maps, Camera USB and Settings actions without claiming control of other app windows. Existing reverse-guide source remains intent-fed and uncalibrated.

features.expected: Exactly one draggable transparent DeX Camera shortcut with the same action as in-app Camera
features.gap: Single transparent draggable shortcut plus explicit camera display-affinity source exist; DeX display routing still requires real-device QA.
features.actual: OverlayService creates one transparent draggable camera ImageButton on the resolved external display. UsbCameraActivity only reuses a camera already on that display, relaunches to the requested display when needed, and refuses an unspecified-display fallback if explicit display launch fails.

features.expected: DeX auto-launch, multiple displays, freeform windows, zone overlays and layout persistence
features.gap: Samsung DeX receiver is now exported for actual system broadcast delivery and validates real desktop/external-display state before acting; OEM background-activity launch behavior, full zone orchestration and real-device acceptance remain open.
features.actual: DexUtils detects desktop/external displays; OverlayService follows display changes with per-display persistence; the exported DexDockReceiver can receive Samsung ENTER/EXIT_KNOX_DESKTOP_MODE broadcasts, launches V2 Home only when a real external DeX display exists, and ignores EXIT while external DeX is still active before stopping the V2 overlay.

features.expected: Multi-zone/slot dashboard management with saved/default layouts and relaunch
features.gap: Local saved/default Home state is versioned and recovered safely. User-visible save/apply/default/delete mutations require synchronous persistence success before reporting success. Automatic corrupt-state cleanup and normalization for both saved and default HOME configurations now use synchronous commit() and log persistence failure. Stale/deleted saved-layout shortcut references are cleaned synchronously; layout deletion reports a partial-cleanup warning if shortcut cleanup cannot persist. Exact V1 shortcut icon artwork, full multi-zone orchestration, and real-device DeX acceptance remain open.
features.actual: HomeActivity saves/applies/removes versioned local Home configurations and assigns/migrates unique stable config IDs. User-visible mutations use synchronous commit() and surface failure. Automatic recovery/normalization of saved and default HOME JSON also commit synchronously and log failed persistence; HomeActivity contains no SharedPreferences.apply() path for these states. Invalid shortcut IDs are synchronously cleared with failure logging, and deleting a layout reports full success only after linked shortcut cleanup commits. Schema-v5 backup/restore validates stable-ID shortcut references.

features.expected: Road/city/theme/day/night/video/custom image Home backgrounds
features.gap: Verified day/night backgrounds plus user-selected image/video backgrounds are implemented without broad storage permission. User-visible appearance changes now require synchronous preference persistence; custom-background replacement commits the new URI/kind before releasing the previous persisted URI grant, and clear commits preference removal before releasing the old grant. Exact V1 theme catalog/media parity and real-device video/background acceptance remain open.
features.actual: AppearanceActivity commits day/night mode before refreshing status. For a custom image/video it first acquires the new SAF grant, commits the new V2 background state, releases the new grant on commit failure when safe, and only after successful commit releases a different previous grant. Clearing a custom background commits preference removal before releasing the previous URI grant.

features.expected: Shortcut bar/map applications and bottom actions/image/music
features.gap: Nine assignable/launchable slots exist. Quick-slot writes are synchronously committed and surfaced as failure if persistence fails; malformed stored quick-slot JSON is logged and synchronously cleared so corrupt state cannot silently survive relaunch. Full V1 bottom-zone behavior/parity and real-device persistence acceptance remain open.
features.actual: QuickBarGrid renders exactly nine slots in three rows; long press assigns/removes supported presets or package targets and click launches package/camera targets. saveQuickSlot synchronously commits bounded nine-slot JSON before rendering success. quickSlots() recovers malformed JSON by removing the corrupt preference with commit() and logs cleanup failure instead of silently continuing with persistent corruption.

features.expected: GPS, battery/weather/telemetry and diagnostics zone
features.gap: Real Android battery and foreground GPS diagnostics are implemented in source; weather provider, full V1 telemetry presentation and real-device location acceptance remain open.
features.actual: TelemetryActivity reads sticky Android battery state, requests foreground fine/coarse location permission, shows the freshest last-known GPS/network location and requests one fresh fix from an enabled provider. Weather is explicitly left unconnected until a verified V1/provider contract exists.

features.expected: OBD/Bluetooth pairing, speed/rpm/battery and diagnostics
features.gap: Paired-device selection, RFCOMM OBD session and speed/RPM/adapter-voltage parsing are implemented in source. Connection lifecycle now tracks both the published socket and an in-flight candidate socket, closes the pending candidate on reconnect/Activity stop/destroy, fences stale generations before and after blocking connect/initialization, and marshals connected-state UI plus telemetry handoff through the UI thread with Activity lifecycle guards. Actual adapter pairing/connection, vehicle compatibility and real telemetry acceptance require device/vehicle QA.
features.actual: ObdActivity opens system Bluetooth settings for pairing, lists bonded devices with BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission, connects by RFCOMM SPP, publishes a socket only after initialization succeeds, and keeps the in-flight candidate separately cancellable so reconnect/stop/destroy cannot leave a stale blocking connect ahead of the next single-threaded session. It closes stale/failed candidates, guards generation/lifecycle transitions, and only starts telemetry after a guarded UI-thread connected transition. ObdProtocol parses speed, RPM and voltage without claiming V1 UI parity.

features.expected: Taxi meter, trip distance/time/rates/history/revenue
features.gap: Foreground GPS trip distance/time, Owner-configured rate, local trip history and revenue are implemented in source. Rate, completed-trip history and explicit history deletion require synchronous persistence success before UI acknowledgement. Corrupt stored trip-history JSON is now fail-visible in logs and removed with synchronous commit() before the screen proceeds with an empty history. Real-device GPS accuracy, V1 tariff semantics/UI parity and long-trip behavior are not accepted.
features.actual: TaxiMeterActivity tracks foreground-only elapsed time and GPS distance, uses only an explicit Owner-entered VND/km rate, commits the rate before starting, commits bounded history before saved acknowledgement, and only refreshes explicit delete after durable persistence. If stored Taxi history is malformed, the app logs it, synchronously clears the corrupt preference with failure logging, and returns an empty local history. No V1 tariff is guessed.

features.expected: Profile, identity/license, greeting and registration/extension
features.gap: The verified V1 V66 original Profile-header subtitle behavior is reflected in V2: real installed V2 version/build appears directly under the Profile title in red, with no floating version badge. Driver-name edits from both Profile and Home now require synchronous persistence before UI acknowledgement/rerender. Identity/license backend, registration/extension, remaining exact V1 card styling and real-device Profile acceptance remain unverified and are intentionally not fabricated.
features.actual: ProfileActivity renders the runtime V2 version/build as the red header subtitle at the original Profile location, keeps version/update actions inside normal cards rather than a floating badge, and edits the same device-local driver display name used by Home. Profile and Home driver-name mutations commit synchronously and surface storage failure. License/registration remains fail-closed until a verified backend contract exists.

features.expected: User/notification tabs and independent update checking
features.gap: Kênh V2 TEST vẫn fail-closed cho tới khi có APK V2 TEST ký số được phát hành. Source tải/cài dựa trên bằng chứng V1 V69: redirect HTTPS giới hạn qua host phát hành GitHub, cache riêng, kiểm SHA-256 + package + exact versionCode + exact versionName + signer pin/continuity rồi mới mở Android system installer. Android unknown-sources và màn hình xác nhận cài đặt vẫn bắt buộc; không có auto-install. Publication của signed APK, device installation acceptance, remote push/backend và exact V1 notification parity còn mở.
features.actual: ProfileActivity tách CẬP NHẬT và THÔNG BÁO. UpdateActivity chỉ tin metadata canonical V2 TEST, tải candidate qua bounded trusted redirect chain, fsync cache, kiểm SHA-256/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName/certificate và signer continuity, rồi mới bật nút mở Android system installer. Unknown-sources vẫn qua Android settings và người dùng vẫn phải xác nhận cài; không shell/ADB/auto-install.

features.expected: Backup/export/import/restore all user settings/images/layout/shortcuts/sound/vehicle with security-bound exclusions
features.gap: Backup schema v5 bao phủ Home/quick slots/saved configs/five stable saved-layout shortcuts/vehicle/DeX overlay/Taxi Meter. Restore vẫn validate toàn bộ payload trước ghi; giờ còn chụp snapshot của mọi preference domain bị ảnh hưởng trước commit đầu tiên và thực hiện rollback đồng bộ theo thứ tự ngược nếu bất kỳ commit nào thất bại. SharedPreferences không cung cấp transaction đa-file nguyên tử, nên rollback là best-effort và lỗi rollback được ghi log/fail-visible. Device/provider-bound custom background grants, V1 images/sound/feature data chưa triển khai và real-device acceptance vẫn mở.
features.actual: Schema-v5 restore: HomeActivity xuất schema v5 qua SAF và validate đầy đủ trước mutation. Trước restore, V2 chụp snapshot Home, saved-layout shortcuts, overlay và Taxi Meter theo đúng domain cần thay. Mỗi domain commit() đồng bộ; nếu một commit thất bại, rollbackRestoreAndFail() khôi phục snapshot theo thứ tự Taxi → overlay → shortcut → Home, ghi lỗi nếu rollback không hoàn tất và không báo restore thành công. Legacy schemas vẫn không phá các field mới; không đọc/ghi V1, credential hay broad storage.

features.expected: Language/theme/appearance/color palettes
features.gap: Appearance now has a dedicated surface for the verified day/night mode and custom user media; V1 language mapping and color-palette semantics are still unverified and intentionally not invented.
features.actual: Home settings opens AppearanceActivity. It changes the existing day/night preference and manages user-selected custom image/video backgrounds while explicitly leaving language and V1 palette parity open.

features.expected: Administrative/licensing/customer activation/device registration where legitimately available
features.gap: A real V2 administrative/license status surface now exists, but it is deliberately read-only and fail-closed because no verified V1/backend contract for customer activation, license extension or device registration is available. Actual backend integration and runtime acceptance remain open.
features.actual: ProfileActivity opens AdminLicenseActivity, which shows the installed V2 package/version/device model and explicitly reports license backend, customer activation and device registration as unavailable until a verified contract exists. It performs no network call, collects no credential and exposes no activation/registration mutation.

features.expected: Data export/reporting sheets where supported by V1
features.gap: A dedicated V2 report hub summarizes V2-owned Taxi Meter trip count, distance, duration and recorded revenue and exports CSV through Storage Access Framework. Malformed stored Taxi history is logged and synchronously cleared before reporting proceeds with an empty dataset. Exact V1 XLS/report templates, dashboards and other feature-domain exports remain unverified and are not claimed.
features.actual: ProfileActivity opens ReportActivity, which reads bounded local V2 Taxi Meter history, rejects malformed row scalars, recovers corrupt history JSON with synchronous preference cleanup plus failure logging, shows aggregate trip/revenue/distance/time and exports stable UTF-8 BOM CSV through user-selected SAF. It requests no broad storage permission and exports no credentials or V1 data.

features.expected: Permissions for camera/USB/geolocation/overlay/update package/privacy/error recovery
features.gap: Runtime source có fail-visible CAMERA gate, location/Bluetooth/overlay state và package-install channel dựa trên V1 V69 nhưng hẹp hơn: signed APK phải qua metadata/hash/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName/signer verification trước; FileProvider chỉ lộ cache updates; unknown-sources và Android installer confirmation là bắt buộc. Privacy-policy parity và full real-device validation vẫn chưa nghiệm thu.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity chỉ khởi động UVC sau CAMERA runtime grant; PrivacyActivity hiển thị permission state và mở OS settings khi cần. UpdateActivity tải candidate vào cache riêng, giới hạn redirect/size, kiểm SHA-256, ZIP/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName, signer pin + signer continuity, rồi dùng FileProvider mở Android system installer. Không broad storage, shell, ADB hay silent install.

features.expected: Responsive portrait/phone/landscape/DeX two/three-column profile cards without clipping
features.gap: Profile source now reflows one/two/three columns by width for compact phone, landscape/tablet and wide DeX, but exact V1 card styling and real-device clipping acceptance are still open.
features.actual: ProfileActivity groups local profile, runtime version/update, fail-closed identity/license status, and V2 trip reporting into responsive cards. ProfileLayoutRules uses 1 column below 600dp, 2 columns at 600–959dp and 3 columns at 960dp+; Android recreation on configuration changes rebuilds the layout.

features.expected: Crash/restart, offline/backups, migration, coexistence, signing and rollback
features.gap: Local migration/recovery and schema-v5 backup source now preserve bounded V2 Taxi Meter history plus five stable-ID Home saved-layout shortcut assignments while keeping schemas 1–4 backward readable. Actual signed release provenance, downgrade/rollback execution and real-device recovery acceptance remain open.
features.actual: V2 has an independent package, lifecycle/UVC cleanup, versioned Home-state migration and a bounded SAF backup envelope. Schema-v5 restore validates shortcut references against the imported saved-config set before writes and replaces only the V2 shortcut mapping; legacy backups remain readable without inventing shortcut data. RecoveryActivity reads real installed package/version/current signing identity; no installer protections are bypassed.
